structure RState : Type where
  p : PState
  applied : w64
  pci : w64
  snap : Bool
  cidx : Nat
  cfg : CCState
  fp : List EntryM

theorem preadRespondAll_role (id : w64) (s : PState) (qs : List ReadReq) : (preadRespondAll id s
    qs).role = s.role

def AdmFold (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (l : List EntryM) (cs : CCState) : Prop :=
  cfgFold dec c0 l = some cs

theorem NoUndecConfIn.mono_dec {d1 d2 : CCDec} (h : DecLe d1 d2) {l : List EntryM} {lo hi : Nat} (hn
    : NoUndecConfIn d1 l lo hi) : NoUndecConfIn d2 l lo hi

def RState.full (r : RState) : List EntryM :=
  r.fp ++ r.p.log

theorem StepR.mono {Adm Adm' : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int} (hA
    : ∀ (l : List EntryM) (cs : CCState), Adm l cs → Adm' l cs) {r : RState} {ms : List Msg} {r' :
    RState} (h : StepR Adm dec id B r ms r') : StepR Adm' dec id B r ms r'

theorem StepR.mono_dec {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec dec' : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int}
    (hd : DecLe dec dec') {r : RState} {ms : List Msg} {r' : RState} (h : StepR Adm dec id B r ms
    r') : StepR Adm dec' id B r ms r'

def NoConfIn (l : List EntryM) (lo hi : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), lo ≤ k → k < hi → l[k]? = some e → ¬IsConfEnt e

inductive StepR (Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop) (dec : CCDec) (id : w64) (B : Int) : RState →
    List Msg → RState → Prop
  | StepR.refl {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int} (r : RState)
      : StepR Adm dec id B r [] r
  | StepR.trans {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int} (r₀ :
      RState) (m₁ : List Msg) (r₁ : RState) (m₂ : List Msg) (r₂ : RState) : StepR Adm dec id B r₀ m₁
      r₁ → StepR Adm dec id B r₁ m₂ r₂ → StepR Adm dec id B r₀ (m₁ ++ m₂) r₂
  | StepR.higherTerm {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int} (m :
      Msg) (r : RState) : uint.Z r.p.term < uint.Z m.term → m.dst = id → (fromLeader m.ty = true →
      m.src ≠ id) → StepR Adm dec id B r [m] { p := pbecomeFollower r.p m.term (if fromLeader m.ty =
      true then m.src else W64 0), applied := r.applied, pci := W64 0, snap := r.snap, cidx :=
      r.cidx, cfg := r.cfg, fp := r.fp }
  | StepR.campaign {Adm : List EntryM → CCState → Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int} (r :
      RState) (peers : List w64) (cl : List w8) : r.p.role ≠ Role.leader → id ∈ r.cfg.cfg.voters →
      r.snap = false → NoConfIn r.full (uint.nat r.applied) (uint.nat r.p.commit) → uint.Z r.p.term
      + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → peers.Perm (elements (r.cfg.cfg.voters \ {id})) → StepR Adm dec id B r [] { p

theorem NoConfIn.noUndec {dec : CCDec} {l : List EntryM} {lo hi : Nat} (h : NoConfIn l lo hi) :
    NoUndecConfIn dec l lo hi

def propBatch (r : RState) (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option ConfChangeIM)) : List EntryM ×
    w64 :=
  propConf r.applied (plastIndex r.p) r.pci ents cs r.cfg.cfg.joint

def NoUndecConfIn (dec : CCDec) (l : List EntryM) (lo hi : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
    lo ≤ k → k < hi → l[k]? = some e → IsConfEnt e → dec (List.take k l) e = some CCDecision.reject
